WITH customer_months AS (
    SELECT tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal') THEN 1 END) AS eligible_rows
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')
),
latest_months AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(month_start) AS latest_month, COUNT(*) AS month_count
    FROM customer_months
    WHERE eligible_rows > 0
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT tx.txn_type, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.customer_id) AS customers,
       MIN(tx.txn_date) AS first_date, MAX(tx.txn_date) AS last_date,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(tx.txn_date) IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS invalid_dates,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN tx.txn_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_amounts,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.customer_id) FROM main.customer_nodes AS n) AS node_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_months) AS deposit_withdrawal_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_months WHERE month_count = 1) AS single_month_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_months AS l
        LEFT JOIN customer_months AS p ON p.customer_id = l.customer_id
          AND p.month_start = DATE(l.latest_month, '-1 month') AND p.eligible_rows > 0
        WHERE l.month_count > 1 AND p.customer_id IS NULL) AS customers_with_latest_gap,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest_months
        WHERE latest_month < (SELECT MAX(latest_month) FROM latest_months)) AS customers_ending_earlier
FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
GROUP BY tx.txn_type

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        tx.customer_id,
        DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE tx.txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN tx.txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -tx.txn_amount
        END) AS net_amount
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
    WHERE tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance,
        net_amount
    FROM monthly_net
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        closing_balance - net_amount AS prior_month_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_balances
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN prior_month_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_month_balance) * 100.0 / prior_month_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM latest_balances
    WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM customer_growth
LIMIT 1
